one_line: Early Gond chief of Garha, remembered as a forest-frontier ruler in the upper Narmada valley c. 14th–15th century CE.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but wiry with a sturdy, outdoors-trained build
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones and a straight nose, medium-brown central Indian complexion, faint sun-lines at the eyes, a short trimmed moustache and light stubble along the jaw, calm but alert eyes with a default expression of composed, watchful determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a medium-length tied knot at the back of the head, sides neat, with a narrow dark-red cloth headband wrapped low across the forehead and knotted at the back, ends tucked in.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length dark-forest-green cotton angarkha-style tunic wrapping left over right and tied with inner and outer ties, the edges piped with narrow off-white trim; over this a sleeveless, slightly quilted russet-brown cotton vest for light protection; below, he has undyed off-white, slightly tapered churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; around his waist is a broad woven belt in muted red and black geometric bands that also supports a sheath; on his feet are simple dark-brown leather sandals with side straps; a plain, slightly weathered dark-ochre cotton shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his torso and pinned at the right hip, usable as a cloak in the forest; jewellery is minimal—one small brass hoop earring in each ear and a single simple brass bangle on his right wrist—signalling modest status rather than heavy royal ornament.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron-tipped spear about his height and a half, with a dark wooden shaft wrapped in narrow leather at the gripping section and a small bunch of black and red dyed cotton cords tied just below the spearhead, carried in his right hand or slung across his shoulder as a symbol of a forest chief who commands both hunt and war.

ref_desc: Jadurai is a mid-30s lean Gond chief with a medium-brown complexion, black hair in a back knot with a dark-red headband, wearing a dark-forest-green angarkha, russet-brown sleeveless vest, off-white churidar trousers, dark-ochre shawl, simple brass jewellery, and carrying a long iron-tipped spear with leather-wrapped shaft and red-black cords.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jadurai, an early 14th–15th century Gond chief from the upper Narmada valley: a mid-30s, lean but sturdy man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, high cheekbones, short trimmed moustache, light jaw stubble, and calm, watchful eyes; his thick black hair is pulled into a medium-length knot at the back, framed by a narrow dark-red cloth headband wrapped across his forehead. He wears a knee-length dark-forest-green cotton angarkha tunic crossing left over right with off-white edging, over which sits a sleeveless slightly quilted russet-brown cotton vest, paired with undyed off-white churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles and simple dark-brown leather sandals. A broad woven belt in muted red and black geometric bands cinches his waist and supports a spear sheath, while a plain dark-ochre cotton shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his torso and pinned at the right hip. Show minimal jewellery: one small brass hoop earring in each ear and a single simple brass bangle on his right wrist. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved iron-tipped spear, taller than he is, with a dark wooden shaft, a leather-wrapped grip section, and a small bundle of black and red cords tied just below the spearhead; depict him holding or resting this spear so it is clearly visible. Emphasize consistent colours—dark forest green, russet brown, off-white, dark ochre, muted red—and keep the overall design grounded, modest, and historically plausible for a forest-frontier Gond ruler.
